As Edwards Lifesciences (EW) Stock Price Rose, Bluestein R H & Company Raised Holding by $9.66 Million Posted by Louis Casey 48 pm
Bluestein R H & Company increased its stake in Edwards Lifesciences (EW) by 35.9% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bluestein R H & Company bought 55,498 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.75% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 210,082 shares of the industrial specialties company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $36.58 million, up from 154,584 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bluestein R H & Company who had been investing in Edwards Lifesciences for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $31.70 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.81% or $1.22 $151.63. About 161,199 shares traded. Edwards Lifesciences Corporation (NYSE:EW) has risen 37.86% uptrending. It has outperformed by 37.86% the S&P500.
Bluestein R H & Company, which manages about $2.94 billion and $2.08 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Alibaba Grp Hldg Ltd Sp Adr (NYSE:BABA) by 145,251 shares to 9,000 shares, valued at $1.48 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Amazon.Com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) by 6,363 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 60,638 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
More news for Edwards Lifesciences Corporation (NYSE:EW) were recently published by: Seekingalpha.com , which released: “Credit Suisse sees 18% upside in Abbott in premarket analyst action – Seeking Alpha” on December 18, 2018.
